moex:WTV6.usd_per_price_unit_basis: MOEX ISS description publishes UNIT=USD, but the exchange-published tick value (STEPPRICE 8.39497 RUB per MINSTEP 0.01 = 839.497 RUB/USD at USD/RUB 84.3275) shows the lot is a fraction of the price unit: 1.0 of price movement is 9.95519848 USD per contract (exchange tick value per contract, per the official specification's variation-margin formula VM = dPrice x W/R).
